title: Branding and link
description: Your madrasa's own link, app name and logo. Staff who open this link see your logo, and the app they install shows your name and icon.
appNameHint: Shown under the app icon on phones and in the browser tab. Keep it short (up to {max} characters).
slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, 3–40 characters.
slugInvalid: Use 3–40 lowercase letters, numbers or dashes, starting and ending with a letter or number.
slugReserved: This link name is reserved. Please choose another.
slugTaken: Another madrasa already uses this link name.
slugChangeWarning: Changing the link breaks the old one: installed apps and shared links will stop working, and staff need the new link.
notSetUpHint: Set a link name below so your staff can use your madrasa's own sign-in page and app.
logoHint: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG up to 5 MB. A square logo with a transparent background looks best.
logoRemoved: The default MMS logo is used again.
logoErrorType: This file type isn't supported. Please use PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG.
logoErrorSize: The file is larger than 5 MB.
logoErrorDecode: This image couldn't be read. Please try another file.
saveFailed: Couldn't save the branding. Please try again.
uploadFailed: The logo couldn't be uploaded. Please try again.
